production_path.admission_rule: the custody slot is reserved before the descriptor of a new name is opened; a refused admission consumes no slot
production_path.custody_lifetime: the whole QS evaluation, until the boundary is closed
production_path.ownership_rule: every successful os.open has exactly one owner until the descriptor is closed: the level openers hand the descriptor to the boundary before they read any metadata, the child and leaf openers own it until the metadata was validated and the custody has taken it over
